rationale: No negation / failure language. The source asks to BUILD new example artifacts on top of an existing, shipped subsystem (FEAT-704, packages/ai-parrot-semantic). The unknown is not 'what is broken' but 'what is the current public surface, what examples already exist, and what conventions must new examples follow'. Named entities: FEAT-704, Semantic Layer, examples/agents/semantic.
